RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of bias. In fields and institutions where panels are often all-male, we don't treat that as proof either. Composition tells you nothing about how criteria were applied; leading with it makes you look like you're reaching, and it lets the university dismiss your complaint as sour grapes.

Your real grounds are concrete: a completed PhD versus an unfinished one, six papers versus two, and four years of teaching for a *teaching* post. Note that "strong industry experience" may have been legitimately weighted — check whether the job ad listed it.

The strongest point is procedural: two weeks' silence on a written reasons request. Press that formally, in writing, citing any statutory deadline.
